reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The static stores one typed unsafe extern C fn() value with used and init_array attributes; REMEMBER_SIGPIPE's owner is the executable image.
owner_creation.invariant: The constructor pointer has zero-argument C ABI.

aliases_escapes.analysis: The loader retains the REMEMBER_SIGPIPE code address; neither the callback code nor the separate INHERITED_SIGPIPE atomic is transferred to a caller.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Loader retention is a borrowed code reference.

callback_targets.analysis: REMEMBER_SIGPIPE stores exactly remember_sigpipe with unsafe extern C fn() ABI; that function queries sigaction without pager dispatch.
callback_targets.invariant: The constructor target cannot vary at runtime.
limitations: Supported Linux x86_64 exec startup only; this does not approve runtime.rs signal-sentinel conversions or the remaining signal handler owners.

invalidation.analysis: The REMEMBER_SIGPIPE entry is immutable and code remains loaded for process lifetime; no callback context or temporary capture can expire.
invalidation.invariant: Constructor invocation cannot refer to stack captures.

mutation_commit.analysis: Link-time initialization fixes the REMEMBER_SIGPIPE entry before loader traversal; there is no dynamic registration or replacement step.
mutation_commit.invariant: Callback target is complete before constructor dispatch.

release_pair.analysis: REMEMBER_SIGPIPE is loader-retained image storage; no unregister/free applies and its code remains live until image destruction.
release_pair.invariant: Loader constructor entries are not allocator-owned.

error_cleanup.analysis: The REMEMBER_SIGPIPE target reads the queried action only on sigaction success, preserving the default saved value on failure.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failed queries do not commit invalid callback data.

signals_handoff.analysis: Invocation happens before Rust main rather than from an application signal handler, so REMEMBER_SIGPIPE does not interrupt a pager owner mutation.
signals_handoff.invariant: The constructor runs before application state exists.
